heroHeadline: Day 799: Three Killed, Homes Shot and Vehicle Torched as Culiacán Violence Continues
heroSubtitle: 799 days of cartel civil war: on September 29, gunmen killed two brick-factory workers in Los Mezcales, a third man was shot in El Vallado Viejo, and a house in Juntas de Humaya was fired on and a vehicle set ablaze with three people inside. Days of open civil war: 799+.
